description: Compare an essay against a word limit. Inputs: text, limit (the maximum word count), optional minimum (a lower bound), optional tolerance_percent (how far over the limit is still acceptable, default 0, a common rule is 10), optional exclude_references (cut everything from a heading line such as References, Works Cited or Bibliography to the end) and     optional exclude_quotes (leave out block quotes that start with > and text inside double quotes). Returns the counted words, how many are left or over, and what was excluded. Example: "Is this under 2000 words if I leave out the works cited and quotes?.

exclude_quotes.description: Leave out quoted passages. Default false.

exclude_references.description: Leave out the references section. Default false.

tolerance_percent.description: Percent over the limit that is still fine. Default 0.

name: check_word_limit
title: Check a word limit
